senses.gloss:
वैभव वैभव, अम्, n. (fr. वि-भव), su-
perhuman power or might; power, greatness, majesty,
grandeur, glory, magnificence, splendor, wealth.

वैभाजित्र वैभाजित्र, अम्, n. (fr. विभाज-
यितृ), apportioning, dividing; apportionment.

वैभाषिक वैभाषिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-
भाषा), optional, alternative; epithet of one of the
four great schools or systems of Buddhism.

वैभोज वैभोज, आस्, m. pl., N. of a tribe
(said to have been descended from Druhyu).

वैभ्र वैभ्र, अम्, n. (etymology doubtful;
said to be fr. वि-भ्राज्), the heaven of Viṣṇu.

वैभ्राज वैभ्राज, अम्, n. (fr. वि-भ्राज्), the
garden of the gods, a celestial grove or garden; N.
of a forest (said to be situated on the west of Meru).
—वैभ्राज-लोक, अस्, m. the world or place inha-
bited by the Manes called Barhi-shads.
